hints.title: Full Signal Construction
hints.text: Transform each word into its full concatenated signal string and count the distinct representations.

hints.title: Letter Code Lookup
hints.text: Map each character to its corresponding dots and dashes pattern using the static lookup table.

hints.title: Unique Set Accumulation
hints.text: Concatenate the code representations for all letters in each word, insert each transformed string into a set, and return the set cardinality.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Linear scan translating words and collecting in hash set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string comparisons take quadratic O(W^2 * L) time instead of set deduplication.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set stores distinct transformed representations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use fixed 26-element array and map each character in O(1) time.
